column7:
Reduction in provision of
` 3.00 lakh was the net
effect of increase of
`3.00 lakh and decrease
by re-appropriation of
`6.00 lakh. Increase was
attributed to additional
amount for medical
expenditure. Decrease
was attributed to
anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(August 2023).

Surrender of ` 5.60 lakh
was attributed to get fund
from third supplementary
for payment of salary and
honorarium of contract
workers, food etc. of the
students of Government
Blind Schools. Reasons
for final saving have not
been intimated (August
2023).
